title: Concept: absent X-Content-Type-Options
description: Without X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff a browser may re-interpret a response as a different type than the server declared, so a text upload can become an executable script. The sniffing decision happens inside the browser and is invisible in the body.
applicability: Responses that serve user-uploaded or user-influenced content.
risk: MIME confusion enabling script execution from a non-script type; MEDIUM severity.
